description: List the pre-reasoned market briefings, each with its tier requirement, and the company briefing (equities.company), one listed company per call. Covers macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, listed companies, cross-asset and Bitcoin. Call it first to find the briefing id for a question, then read that briefing with get_context. Pass search with the question's words to get only the briefings that match, best first; when it names a company, the answer also lists the matching covered companies, each with the entity to pass to get_context. For one data series rather than a briefing, use list_metrics. Every covered company, by market, is listed at GET https://api.prereason.com/api/companies, with no key needed. No authentication required.

search.description: The question or its key words (for example "is the yield curve inverted" or "Toyota earnings"). Returns the matching briefings, best first, at most five, and any covered companies it names (at most five).

tier.description: Filter briefings by subscription tier (free, basic, or pro). Returns all tiers if omitted.

name: list_briefings
title: List Briefings
